title: Hybrid streaming + toolcall conformance orchestrator and regression plan
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an orchestrator harness and regression plan that validates end-to-end compatibility for hybrid streaming + function/tool calling paths across runtime variants and model shims. The harness will exercise: 1) multiplexed streaming with interleaved tool calls, 2) NDJSON and structured output roundtrips, 3) canonical golden prompts + negative/generative edge cases, and 4) fallback routing to compatible model variants. The goal is: deterministic contract checks in CI, nightly regression runs with drift alerts, and a lightweight canary that runs on every runtime or model change.
acceptance_criteria: CI gate job 'conformance/hybrid-stream-toolcall' fails if any contract assertion regresses
Golden prompt corpus (stable seed set) produces identical structural fingerprints across runtime-1.18 and runtime-1.19-stub within tolerance thresholds
NDJSON structured output roundtrip test passes for 95% of cases in nightly run; failures generate an automated ticket with payload and diff
Orchestrator can simulate tool call latencies and verify idempotent toolcall replay and KV cache priming behavior
New model shims can be validated in <30m using the harness and produce a compatibility score shown in Console
tasks: Design harness API for synthetic traffic generation (stream + toolcall interleave)
Define golden prompt corpus and negative cases (edge-cases, partial JSON, out-of-order tokens)
Implement serializer/deserializer validators for NDJSON and multipart stream frames
Create contract assertions library (shape, sequence ids, toolcall lifecycle events, retries)
Integrate harness with CI: PR gate + nightly job + canary pipeline
Add dashboards: flaky test heatmap, regression diff explorer, per-model compatibility score
Document runbook and failure triage steps in Confluence
decisions: Use deterministic seeded generation for golden prompts to reduce flakiness in CI
Represent 'security_review_required' as a flag in the ticket metadata; this harness does not touch customer data so it remains false
Opt to fail fast on schema mismatches but only warn on token-level semantic divergence; this keeps CI actionable
Prefer lightweight Node-based harness agent (reuses existing stream clients) rather than heavyweight simulator to speed iteration

2025-02-24: PoC serializer validator implemented; NDJSON roundtrip tests pass locally against chrome-model-shim
2025-03-01: CI integration spike complete: added prototype job 'conformance/hybrid-stream-toolcall' to smoke pipeline (experimental)
2025-03-04: Found a flaky scenario with toolcall retry ordering when simulated latency >250ms; added deterministic ordering step to harness and filed ENG-96102 as follow-up
test_plan: PR gate: lightweight smoke run (10 seeds) that checks event ordering and basic schema assertions
Nightly: full golden corpus (42 seeds + 12 negatives) with model-matrix expansion across curated shims and quantized variants
Canary: incremental canary run on 1% of traffic replicating real prefixes and toolcall sequences
Fuzzing: mutation-based fuzz suite that injects partial frames, dropped bytes, and out-of-order chunks to assert graceful degradation
Deterministic replay: store golden session traces for fast bisecting between runtime changes
Coverage: target increasing CI coverage of streaming/toolcall edge behaviors to 85% of known contract assertions
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (week 0-2): internal PoC and golden corpus stabilization
Phase 2 (week 3-4): CI integration and PR gating for runtime changes
Phase 3 (week 5): Nightly full regression and dashboard shipping
Phase 4 (ongoing): Alerting + auto-ticket creation for regressions and periodic corpus refresh
risks: Flaky tests due to non-deterministic model outputs — mitigated via structural/fingerprint assertions instead of exact token matching
Increased CI latency — mitigated by keeping PR gate small and delegating full runs to nightly jobs
False positives from shim differences — mitigation: compatibility score thresholding and human triage workflow
Test data drift as models change — mitigation: quarterly review of golden corpus and seeded retraining of fingerprints
notes: When a failure occurs, the harness will upload a minimal trace (no customer PII) and link to the failing seed in the auto-created ticket
We will expose a Console widget that shows 'compatibility delta' for every PR that touches runtime selection, kernel selection, or streaming glue code
Follow-up epic: roll this harness into Dedicated onboarding tests for customer-specific shims
